premises: Ultrasonic burnishing refines near-surface grain structure in FeNiCrCoCu coatings
Refined grain boundaries promote formation of a stable, adherent oxide layer during high-temperature sliding
The oxide layer and increased hardness reduce dislocation-mediated plastic deformation
